name: desktop-upstream.lock
watches: upstream pins only; this fork is not the subject of this file

desktop.note: Upstream Desktop baseline. This fork pins the Harness (see `harness`), not an upstream Desktop commit, so `commit` stays null until an operator resolves a revision with --desktop-commit. The Desktop base version this fork derives from is recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. This fork's own HEAD is never written here.

policy: Upgrade only through PR + tests; never follow master/latest automatically.
